quote: Saraswati (also Sarasvati) is the Hindu goddess of learning, wisdom, music, and aesthetics.

statement.id: Saraswati adalah dewi pembelajaran, kebijaksanaan, musik, dan estetika Hindu.
statement.en: Saraswati is the Hindu goddess of learning, wisdom, music, and aesthetics.

quote: As Vac, she is the goddess of speech.

statement.id: Sebagai Vac, ia dipandang sebagai dewi ujaran.
statement.en: As Vac, she is the goddess of speech.

quote: Saraswati first appears in the Rigveda and, in later religious texts, she is identified as the inventor of Sanskrit and, appropriately, gives Ganesha the gifts of pen and inks.

statement.id: Saraswati pertama kali muncul dalam Rigveda; dalam teks keagamaan yang lebih belakangan ia disebut penemu bahasa Sanskerta dan memberi Ganesha karunia pena dan tinta.
statement.en: Saraswati first appears in the Rigveda; in later religious texts she is identified as the inventor of Sanskrit and gives Ganesha the gifts of pen and ink.

quote: The goddess has her own festivals, notably the Saraswati Puja, held on the first day of spring.

statement.id: Saraswati Puja dirayakan pada hari pertama musim semi.
statement.en: Saraswati Puja is held on the first day of spring.

quote: Another object commonly seen in Saraswati's hands is the vina (the Hindu classical music instrument) which reminds of her gift of music to humanity.

statement.id: Vina sering digambarkan berada di tangan Saraswati.
statement.en: Saraswati is often depicted holding a vina.

quote: Her attributes—the vina (a symbol of music and the arts), palm-sized manuscript (a symbol of learning), and rosary (a symbol of religious rites)—denote her role as a goddess of knowledge.

statement.id: Vina, manuskrip, dan tasbih menjadi atributnya yang melambangkan musik, pembelajaran, dan ritus.
statement.en: Her vina, manuscript, and rosary symbolize music, learning, and ritual.

quote: Saraswati is conventionally accompanied by a swan, but a peacock stands beside her here, enchanted by the divine music she creates.

statement.id: Saraswati secara konvensional ditemani angsa, sementara satu cetakan menampilkan merak.
statement.en: Saraswati is conventionally accompanied by a swan, though this print shows a peacock.

quote: Originally associated with an ancient lost river that bore her name, Saraswati increasingly came to be celebrated as the goddess of all waters and their life-giving and purifying powers.

statement.id: Saraswati awalnya terkait sungai kuno senama, lalu dipuja sebagai dewi seluruh perairan.
statement.en: Saraswati was associated with a lost river of the same name and later with all waters.

quote: She is also known as Bharati (eloquence), Shatarupa (existence), Vedamata ('mother of the Vedas'), Brahmi, Sarada, Vagisvari, and Putkari.

statement.id: Ia juga dikenal sebagai Bharati (kefasihan), Shatarupa (keberadaan), Vedamata ('ibu para Veda'), Brahmi, Sarada, Vagisvari, dan Putkari.
statement.en: She is also known as Bharati (eloquence), Shatarupa (existence), Vedamata ('mother of the Vedas'), Brahmi, Sarada, Vagisvari, and Putkari.

quote: She is also a patron of the arts and sciences, and the wife of Brahma, even if the Bengal Vaisnavas considered her first the wife of Vishnu.

statement.id: Ia juga pelindung seni dan ilmu pengetahuan serta istri Brahma, meskipun kaum Waisnawa Bengal menganggapnya lebih dulu sebagai istri Vishnu.
statement.en: She is also a patron of the arts and sciences and the wife of Brahma, although the Bengal Vaisnavas considered her first the wife of Vishnu.

quote: Saraswati's name means 'elegant', 'flowing', and 'watery' and this is indicative of her status as one of the early Aryan boundary rivers.

statement.id: Nama Saraswati berarti 'anggun', 'mengalir', dan 'berair', dan ini menunjukkan statusnya sebagai salah satu sungai batas Arya awal.
statement.en: Saraswati's name means 'elegant', 'flowing', and 'watery', which indicates her status as one of the early Aryan boundary rivers.

quote: The Saraswati River (modern name: Sarsuti), just like the Ganges River, flows from the Himalaya and is considered a sacred source of purification, fertility, and good fortune for those who bathe in her waters. The sacred river, again like the Ganges, then developed into a personified deity.

statement.id: Sungai Saraswati (nama modern: Sarsuti), seperti Sungai Gangga, mengalir dari Himalaya dan dianggap sumber suci penyucian, kesuburan, dan keberuntungan bagi mereka yang mandi di airnya; sungai suci itu kemudian berkembang menjadi dewi yang dipersonifikasikan.
statement.en: The Saraswati River (modern name Sarsuti), like the Ganges, flows from the Himalaya and is considered a sacred source of purification, fertility, and good fortune for those who bathe in it; the sacred river then developed into a personified deity.

quote: During the festival, worshippers wear yellow, which is associated with wisdom and prosperity. Statues of the goddess are also draped in yellow silk, and believers pray for blessings on their pens, books, and musical instruments.

statement.id: Selama perayaan, para pemuja mengenakan pakaian kuning yang dikaitkan dengan kebijaksanaan dan kemakmuran; arca sang dewi dibalut sutra kuning, dan umat memohon berkah bagi pena, buku, dan alat musik mereka.
statement.en: During the festival worshippers wear yellow, which is associated with wisdom and prosperity; statues of the goddess are draped in yellow silk, and believers pray for blessings on their pens, books, and musical instruments.

quote: Children are taught to write for the first time during the festival, Brahmin priests are given fine food, and ancestors are venerated.

statement.id: Pada perayaan itu anak-anak diajari menulis untuk pertama kalinya, para pendeta Brahmana diberi hidangan istimewa, dan leluhur dihormati.
statement.en: During the festival children are taught to write for the first time, Brahmin priests are given fine food, and ancestors are venerated.

quote: As the patron of music, she is frequently prayed to by musicians before concerts and, as a goddess of intellectual pursuits, by students before examinations.

statement.id: Sebagai pelindung musik, ia sering didoakan para musisi sebelum konser, dan sebagai dewi kegiatan intelektual, oleh pelajar sebelum ujian.
statement.en: As the patron of music she is frequently prayed to by musicians before concerts, and as a goddess of intellectual pursuits by students before examinations.

quote: Saraswati is also worshipped along with other major goddesses in the pan-Indian celebration of Navaratri.

statement.id: Saraswati juga dipuja bersama dewi-dewi utama lain dalam perayaan Navaratri yang dirayakan di seluruh India.
statement.en: Saraswati is also worshipped along with other major goddesses in the pan-Indian celebration of Navaratri.

quote: In Hindu mythology, Saraswati is the wife of the great god Brahma. However, according to some traditions, she was first the wife of Vishnu.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Hindu, Saraswati adalah istri dewa agung Brahma, tetapi menurut sebagian tradisi ia mula-mula istri Vishnu.
statement.en: In Hindu mythology Saraswati is the wife of the great god Brahma, but according to some traditions she was first the wife of Vishnu.

quote: One day, when, awaiting his wife to begin an important religious ceremony and so unable to start the ritual punctually, Brahma asked the gods' advice. They responded by creating a new wife for him, Gayatri, so that the ceremony could go ahead at the precise time.

statement.id: Suatu hari, ketika menunggu istrinya untuk memulai upacara penting sehingga tak dapat memulai ritual tepat waktu, Brahma meminta nasihat para dewa; mereka menciptakan istri baru baginya, Gayatri, agar upacara berjalan pada waktunya.
statement.en: One day, while waiting for his wife to begin an important ceremony and unable to start the ritual on time, Brahma asked the gods' advice; they created a new wife for him, Gayatri, so that the ceremony could proceed at the proper time.

quote: However, when Saraswati eventually turned up she was not best pleased to see her husband with another woman and so cursed Brahma never to be worshipped by humanity (even if he is worshipped today in parts of South-east Asia).

statement.id: Ketika Saraswati akhirnya tiba dan melihat suaminya bersama perempuan lain, ia tidak senang dan mengutuk Brahma agar tidak pernah dipuja manusia (meski kini ia dipuja di sebagian Asia Tenggara).
statement.en: When Saraswati finally arrived and saw her husband with another woman she was displeased and cursed Brahma never to be worshipped by humanity (although he is worshipped today in parts of South-east Asia).

quote: More specifically, Saraswati's son is the rishi (sage) Sarasvata. He, nourished by the bountiful waters of his mother, was able to withstand the Great Drought of Hindu mythology and so survive as the definitive repository of the Vedas sacred texts.

statement.id: Secara khusus, putra Saraswati adalah resi Sarasvata, yang dihidupi air melimpah ibunya, mampu bertahan menghadapi Kekeringan Besar dalam mitologi Hindu dan selamat sebagai penyimpan utama kitab suci Veda.
statement.en: More specifically, Saraswati's son is the rishi (sage) Sarasvata, who, nourished by his mother's bountiful waters, withstood the Great Drought of Hindu mythology and survived as the definitive repository of the Vedas.

quote: In Hindu art, Saraswati is usually depicted as a graceful youth with white skin. She most often wears a white sari (which symbolises purity) which has a blue border.

statement.id: Dalam seni Hindu, Saraswati biasanya digambarkan sebagai remaja anggun berkulit putih, paling sering berkain sari putih (lambang kesucian) bertepi biru.
statement.en: In Hindu art Saraswati is usually shown as a graceful youth with white skin, most often in a white sari (symbolizing purity) with a blue border.

quote: As with many Hindu deities, Saraswati is often depicted with four arms, each holding a symbolic object. In the left hands she can carry a palm-leaf manuscript and ritual water vessel. In the upper right hand she holds a white lotus flower

statement.id: Seperti banyak dewa Hindu, Saraswati sering digambarkan berlengan empat, masing-masing memegang benda lambang; di tangan kiri ia dapat membawa manuskrip daun lontar dan bejana air ritual, dan di tangan kanan atas ia memegang teratai putih.
statement.en: Like many Hindu deities, Saraswati is often shown with four arms, each holding a symbolic object; in the left hands she can carry a palm-leaf manuscript and a ritual water vessel, and in the upper right hand she holds a white lotus.

quote: Alternatively, she may be shown riding her vehicle (vahana), either a swan or goose.

statement.id: Ia juga dapat ditampilkan menunggang kendaraannya (wahana), yaitu angsa atau soang.
statement.en: She may also be shown riding her vehicle (vahana), either a swan or a goose.

quote: Sarasvati is also worshipped as the goddess of learning in Jainism and by some Buddhist sects.

statement.id: Sarasvati juga dipuja sebagai dewi ilmu dalam Jainisme dan oleh beberapa sekte Buddha.
statement.en: Sarasvati is also worshipped as the goddess of learning in Jainism and by some Buddhist sects.

quote: She with her might, like one who digs for lotus-stems, hath burst with her strong waves the ridges of the hills.

statement.id: Dalam himne Rigveda (terjemahan Griffith), Sarasvati dengan kekuatannya menjebol punggung bukit dengan ombaknya yang deras, seperti orang yang menggali batang teratai.
statement.en: In a Rigveda hymn (Griffith's translation), Sarasvati with her might bursts the ridges of the hills with her strong waves, like one who digs for lotus stems.

quote: Thou hast discovered rivers for the tribes of men, and, rich in wealth! made poison flow away from them.

statement.id: Dalam himne Rigveda yang sama, Sarasvati dipuji karena menemukan sungai-sungai bagi suku-suku manusia dan, kaya akan harta, mengalirkan racun menjauh dari mereka.
statement.en: The same Rigveda hymn praises Sarasvati for discovering rivers for the tribes of men and, rich in wealth, making poison flow away from them.

quote: Thou castest down, Sarasvati, those who scorned the Gods, the brood of every Brsaya skilled in magic arts.

statement.id: Dalam himne itu, Sarasvati dikatakan menjatuhkan mereka yang menghina para dewa, yaitu keturunan setiap Brsaya yang mahir ilmu sihir.
statement.en: In the hymn, Sarasvati is said to cast down those who scorned the Gods, the brood of every Brsaya skilled in magic arts.

quote: Seven-sistered, sprung from threefold source, the Five Tribes' prosperer, she must be

statement.id: Dalam himne itu, Sarasvati disebut bersaudara tujuh, berasal dari tiga sumber, dan pemakmur Lima Suku.
statement.en: In the hymn, Sarasvati is called seven-sistered, sprung from a threefold source, and the prosperer of the Five Tribes.

quote: Although one of the most important Hindu gods, Brahma is rarely actively worshipped. In mythology, this is explained as a result of a curse from Saraswati.

statement.id: Meski salah satu dewa Hindu terpenting, Brahma jarang dipuja secara aktif; dalam mitologi hal ini dijelaskan sebagai akibat kutukan Saraswati.
statement.en: Although one of the most important Hindu gods, Brahma is rarely actively worshipped; in mythology this is explained as the result of a curse from Saraswati.
